title: A Letter for the Uniform
author: Noor Thornbury
blurb: Casper Yarrow, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
